program.name: Spine and Hip Flow
program.subject: Yoga flow
program.blurb: Long flows for the two places that stiffen most: the spine and the hips.
program.about: Long, slow flows for the spine and hips. One day waves, bends and twists the spine in every direction; the other circles, lunges and squats through the hips. Both close with a rest. They alternate. Both later levels hold every pose longer.
